cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That cross of tape I copied from yours is still on the curtain. You called it untidy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine marked where a chair goes on the floor. Yours is stuck across a torn seam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, marking the weak point. Leave it until the finale's over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seam's split farther. Your tape is the only thing holding the two halves together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then thank the person who left the untidy cross there. Say that before you ask me to peel it off.

reason: Create a specific misunderstood copied action which determines how A pursues this Drive, preserving useful seed causality and giving B a concrete concern that changes the ending.
